Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Washington, DC for 2026, and here is what he found: 29 family events, 13 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Enchant Christmas at Nationals Park) with Jingle Block Rock (December 2), the Light Yards Express (December 8) and the National Christmas Tree, ZooLights and the Wharf's boat parade along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Washington, DC

  • 29 Christmas events for kids in Washington, DC
  • 13 free events, including Jingle Block Rock at the Southwest Duck Pond (December 2) and the Light Yards Express at The Yards (December 8)
  • Meet Santa: Jingle Block Rock (December 2) and the Santa Suite at the Fairmont
  • Trains: Light Yards Express at The Yards (December 8) and Season's Greenings train display at the US Botanic Garden
  • Shows: Step Afrika Holiday Show at Arena Stage (December 4 to 23) and The Nutcracker
  • Season: November 20 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? DC families also use our guides for Christmas activities for kids in Alexandria, Arlington and Rockville.
